purpose: Create a current truth rollup for Mechanicus organ readiness without claiming assembly closure.
core_doctrine: Readiness rollup is a measured truth index, not an organ closure receipt.
Mechanicus must distinguish proven baseline functions, partial evidence, future capabilities, blockers and forbidden claims.
Mechanicus must not claim organ_assembled, operational_proven, trust_proven, throne_confirmed, red_blue_resilient or no_core_mutation_proven until assembly gates have evidence.
Build proof is not code purity proof; tool inventory is not tool admission; planner recommendation is not execution authority.
The future local model membrane is DEFERRED_FUTURE_CAPABILITY and must not be treated as a Core v1 dependency or near-term patch blocker.

allowed_future_role: translate Owner intent into machine-readable intent envelopes
explain capability/risk/cost based on code-generated reports
route tasks to local scripts, CLI Codex, Grok, chat agent or Owner review
forbidden_future_role: claiming evidence not produced by scripts/validators

verdict_policy.must_remain_not_assembled_until: all assembly gates have current proof and Custodes/Throne validators pass
